preconditions.description: The grid dimensions n (rows) and m (columns) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(0 <= x for x in a)
preconditions.description: The row constraints list 'a' has exactly n elements, each representing a non-negative integer.

preconditions.expression: len(b) == m and all(0 <= x for x in b)
preconditions.description: The column constraints list 'b' has exactly m elements, each representing a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == n and all(len(line) == m for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly n lines, each containing exactly m characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in ['.', '*'] for line in stdout.splitlines() for c in line)
postconditions.description: Each cell in the output grid is either '.' (white) or '*' (black).

postconditions.expression: all(count_black_segments(line) == a[i] for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Each row in the output grid has exactly the specified number of contiguous black segments as given in 'a'.

postconditions.expression: all(count_black_segments(''.join([line[j] for line in stdout.splitlines()])) == b[j] for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each column in the output grid has exactly the specified number of contiguous black segments as given in 'b'.
